crossRefs.note: “It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.
The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.
For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,
covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.
The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil…
If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this…
“You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.
You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.
Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,
Deliver my soul, Yahweh, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?
“They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they…
Their tongue is a deadly arrow. It speaks deceit. One speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in his…
So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

translations.web: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
translations.bsb: For your iniquity instructs your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
translations.kjv: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.
translations.asv: For thine iniquity teacheth thy mouth, And thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.
